svg.aria-label: How Nebius pays for its GPU build-out — and whose pockets the cash lands in
svg.text: How Nebius pays for its GPU build-out — and whose pockets the
Nebius's ~$20-25B 2026 capex and $166M FY2025 COGS fan out across GPUs, power, data-center shells and financing, then pool onto a
handful of chokepoints — above all NVIDIA silicon and the grid.
money embedded in a finished chip
TSMC + SK hynix inside each GPU
Source: Nebius FY2025 20-F (supplier/customer concentration, capex) · Q1 2026 earnings call (capex/power guidance) · Microsoft/Meta deal disclosures · Bloom Energy partnership announcement
